name: craft
description: /craft:atdd runs the 7-step flow. /craft:craft enforces the root rule (less code is better than more code) and triages SOLID, KISS, YAGNI, DRY and Clean Code, reading only the reference of each principle with a signal. /craft:audit audits the whole repo. /craft:setup prepares lint with limits. /craft:hook turns a correction into a project hook. Hooks inject short rules in every session (ASD-STE100 writing, project memory, tasks with a goal, Claude as the tool of the user, research before facts and implementations, and the rule for each code change), deny English-less code, missing data-testid, skipped tests, E2E outside a container, unfiltered tests in a large suite and memory outside the project, and ask about the full suite before a push without CI.
